messages:
incident-bot: Alert: p99 latency spike detected for /v1/generate in prod-us-east-1 — p95 jumped to ~1.2s, p99 ~4.8s, error rate +14% in last 5m. Auto-mitigation kicked: reroute to fallback model disabled (no capacity).
Mira: seeing streaming stalls in the logs — chunk timeouts at ~30s for long-stream sessions.
Akash: confirm: KV cache eviction rate spiked, slab usage at 98%, frequent slab reshuffle events. Looks like fragmentation + aggressive prefill.
Eli: customer impact: two enterprise tenants (accts redwood-orp and atlas-inc) reporting degraded UX and reconnects. CS flagged 3 P1 pages.
Mira: digging into cache metrics now — prefill requests per second >> decode completions per second (prefill: ~6k/s, decode: ~1.2k/s). Prefill queue growing and causing hot-slab pressure.
Akash: this smells like prefill vs decode imbalance — prefill is populating KV entries faster than the decoder can consume, causing eviction churn and long tail reads.
Jordan: any recent deploys to kv-cache config or prefill autoscaler?
Mira: no deploys in the last 2h. We did push a traffic shift for a new customer an hour ago (big seqs), increased concurrent streaming sessions.
Eli: reproducer in staging? Trying to replay a subset with synthetic long-history requests.
Mira: logs snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T12:02:03Z] kv_cache: slab_alloc failure slab_id=7 free=2 req=64
[2026-03-15T12:02:03Z] prefill: enqueued request_id=abc123 size=54 tokens
[2026-03-15T12:02:04Z] decode: completed request_id=def456 duration=920ms
[2026-03-15T12:02:04Z] eviction: removed slab_key=0x7a3cb prefetched=true
```
Mira: p95 tail correlates with eviction bursts — eviction causes cache misses and heavy disk/page IOPS for some shards.
Akash: immediate mitigations we can try: 1) throttle prefill via rate-limit gate, 2) increase slab pool for hot-shards, 3) enable decode-priority scheduling to reduce backlog, 4) route heavy streaming sessions to other pool.
Eli: prioritize mitigations by quickness: (1) throttle prefill gate, (2) enable decode-priority, (3) slab resize if safe.
Mira: applying prefill throttle now — hitting the feature flag: `FLAGS_PREFILL_RATE_LIMIT=6000` -> flip to 2000. Running rollout command: `rhctl flags set PREFILL_RATE_LIMIT 2000 --env prod-us-east-1`
Mira: done — flag rollout at 12:07Z, propagation ~30s. Monitoring p95/p99.
Akash: enabling decode-priority scheduling on nodes hosting hot shards (quick restart of scheduler process). Command: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/decode-scheduler-hot`
Akash: restart done, pods coming up.
Jordan: slab resize: what's the risk? Growing slab reduces fragmentation but may increase memory pressure overall. We need to confirm headroom on hosts.
Mira: checked host mem headroom: ~18% per host on hot pool, can safely bump slab by +15% on affected nodes. Plan: apply slab increase after we verify throttle+scheduler improvement.
incident-bot: Auto-alert update: p95 reduced to ~680ms, p99 down to ~2.1s after prefill throttle and scheduler restart (5m window). Error rate down to +5%.
Eli: good direction. Continue monitoring for 10m. Start drafting postmortem and customer comms. @sre-manager want to loop in account teams?
sre-manager: yes, please ping CS and AMs once we have stable numbers. Also prepare recommended follow-up items: runbook changes, prefilling safeguards, autoscaler tuning.
Mira: telemetry shows eviction bursts still occurring every ~120s. I'll stage slab +15% for hot shards in a controlled subset (2/8 nodes) and assess.
Mira: staging slab bump executed on subset at 12:18Z. Observed immediate reduction in eviction events for those shard pods.
Akash: ops note — schedule a controlled slab resize for all hot nodes during low-traffic window tonight if we confirm metrics. Also create an alert for prefill/encode vs decode imbalance (ratio > 3x) to trigger autoslow.
Eli: Customer impact update: CS reports complaints reduced; no new P1 pages. Two customers still have intermittent reconnects but latency improved.
Jordan: handoff: my oncall window ends in 20m, will prepare a concise runbook for next oncall. @ops-rotation-bot please create handoff: summary + actions.
ops-rotation-bot: Handoff created: https://go/redwood/handoffs/8080808080 — includes mitigations performed, flags toggled, slab changes, metrics links.
Mira: runbook additions to include: - prefill throttle feature flag default = 2000 - decode-priority toggle commands - slab resize checklist + host memory check - traffic-reroute playbook
Akash: follow-up tickets: INF-4123 (prefill autoslow), INF-4124 (slab autoscaler), INF-4125 (alert imbalance ratio), INF-4126 (customer incident report).
Eli: propose a short-term policy: cap concurrent prefill per customer at 20 streams. We'll iterate.
sre-manager: agreed. We'll schedule a postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:30 and notify affected accounts.
Mira: final telemetry at 12:38Z: p95 ~450ms, p99 ~1.1s, error rate <=1.2%. Closing active mitigation channel; handoff complete.
Akash: leaving a note: long-term fix likely requires smarter prefill rate shaping and per-shard slab defragmenter.
Mira: thanks all. If the next oncall sees regressions, follow Handoff link and escalate to infra-reliability.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: service SLO degraded but mitigated — severity: sev2 -> monitoring.
